newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWIMMING-WORLD RECORD FOR CHINA IN WOMEN'S 4X200 RELAY.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-WORLD RECORD FOR CHINA IN WOMEN'S 4X200 RELAY.

text.p: China broke their own women's 4x200 metres freestyle relay world record at the world short-course swimming championships on Thursday.
Wang Luna, Nian Yin, Chen Yan and Shan Ying clocked seven minutes 51.92 seconds to set the second record of the evening on the opening day of the championships.
The time bettered the 7:52.45 set by Shan, Zhou Guanbin, Le Jingyi and Lu Bin at the inaugural world short-course championships in Palma de Mallorca on December 2, 1993.
Sweden were second in a European short-course record 7:56.04, just edging out Australia (7:56.12) in a great battle.
In the preceding race, Australia had broken their own men's 4x100 metres medley relay record.
It was China's second title of the evening after Liu Limin won the women's 200 metres butterfly.
